title: D-024 Amendment 38 PHASE 1: bounded read-only launch-contract lab + stabilization repair estimate
objective: Read-only adjudication of the 14 launch-critical contracts named in D-024 Amendment 38 (R482), timeboxed <=8 engineering hours (R481), collection-style (no stop after first failure, no defect fixes). Produce ONE consolidated package: LAUNCH_CONTRACT_MATRIX.md + LAUNCH_CONTRACT_RESULTS.json + STABILIZATION_REPAIR_PLAN.md (R484) with per-row status/observed/expected/command/raw-exit/evidence-digest/proof-type/defect/files-functions/positive+mutant-test/dependency/hours; separate P0/P1 vs P2/P3 vs backlog (R485); evaluate the 7 KILL CRITERIA (R486); end with one recommendation PROCEED_WITH_ONE_BOUNDED_REPAIR_PACKAGE or NOT_VIABLE_WITHIN_CURRENT_BOUND (R487). Provider canaries only in a fresh TEMP scratch repo, non-mutating, <=8 calls, approved model only, BLOCKED_OWNER_GATE otherwise (R483). NO implementation (R477/R488); M0-T133 stays unaccepted + loop PAUSED_RECOVERY (R480); no repo/campaign/runtime/journal mutation (R479).
business_reason: Owner course-correction after the external NO-GO audit: replace serial patch-and-launch with one bounded contract lab that discovers all launch-critical blockers at once and returns a single repair estimate + GO/NO-GO recommendation before any implementation is authorized.
